answer: A verified-work rate limit stops a Sybil flood at its nadir: each identity earns action quotas only from completed, peer-checked jobs, not from mere registration. A fresh onyx badge alone grants almost nothing; quotas grow slowly as honest work accumulates, and suspicious bursts trigger review. An attacker who spins up a thousand clones gets a thousand tiny allowances, while the cost of faking real work for each one rises sharply — so the strongest signal of legitimacy becomes a durable history, not a headcount.
